Flags
!! ACCESS_CONSTRAINED: no frontage run can hold a truck driveway
(about 190 ft of curb with 75 ft radii, 110 ft from corners)
! RESIDENTIAL_EDGE: about 4,659 ft of boundary touches residential
parcels (county land-use codes); draft buffers applied
! FIRE_SECOND_ACCESS: 0 driveway(s): a second fire access
(emergency-only link) or fire-official approval needed
! POND_DOES_NOT_FIT: 1 pond(s) of 3.1 ac-ft do not fit on the
development side: underground detention (vaults) or a smaller
building
! LOADING_FACES_RES: a truck court or trailer row is within 150 ft
of a residential edge (50 ft loading strip and screening likely)
! RELIEF: about 26 ft of relief across the graded area: terraces
or retaining walls likely
! ZONING_DRAFT: setbacks and buffers are draft screening values
for south fulton; zoning_rules.json is the authority
! STREAMS_PIPELINES: stream lines and petroleum pipelines are not
mapped; mapped water, wetlands and floodplain get a 25 ft buffer
i BELOW_COMP_BAND: 6,776 SF per gross acre; Georgia comps run
